en: Nnnnngh...
(Hmph. That really is inhuman, brute strength.)
I'm on my way to the forest.
Gonna work hard chopping trees again today.
Nice morning. Why don't you come to the forest with me?
I just got back from the forest.
See, I'm a woodcutter, after all.
Like I told you, I'm a woodcutter.
I'm heading home. Wanna come along?
Not today, I'm afraid.
Oh, okay. Come by any time.
Let's have a meal together.
Hey, this is my brother's and my house.
Who are you?
Nice to meet you, I'm
Do you need something from us?
No, I don't have any particular business.
If you've got no business here,
you'd better not go into other people's houses.
Did you need something today?
I've got no business with you myself.
I don't really have any either.
I just dropped in for a bit.
If you've got time to kill, wanna come watch me cut trees?
I cut the trees in the forest, you know.
Hey, I'm glad when you come by.
Come by even if you've got no business.
But honestly, you
sure come to other people's houses a lot for no reason.
Got business in the forest too?
I'm a woodcutter, you see,
so I came to cut trees.
You can watch if you don't get in the way,
but it might be dangerous.
Do you think you'd like to be a woodcutter?
A weakling like you couldn't do it, though.
You've got to be built like me, like this.
Is watching me cut trees fun?
I know you've got nothing better to do, though.
Using the trees I cut,
my brother makes all sorts of things.
I live with my brother,
How about all of us having a meal together
sometime? I bet it'd be fun.
My brother's the more skilled one, sure,
but nobody beats me when it comes to strength.
Hm... Oh, it's you.
You really do seem to have incredible strength.
It looks like it would be very useful.
I'm proud of my strength, after all.
I want you to put it to use for me, too...
